I was trying to draw from my own experience living on my own in a dorm for the first time where I let a gallon of milk spoil in my trash can and dripped the most foul-smelling liquid I've ever inhaled in my life as I took it out to throw it away.

Got a wellness check from an RA posse and had to mop my whole floor's hallway to clean up after myself that night.

Coldposted for the one-two punch of procrastinating on anything contest related or cleaning out the actual fridge that exists in my house. This idea popped into my head fully formed and I had to write it before I lost it. It's really funny to me so I hope it's kinda funny to some of those who read it.

Image Credit

The title is Fridge Horror, and I tried to load it with as much of that as I could while still having a good joke. Post if/when the implications of what's here hit you later on? :)
